security.title: Security
security.best_practices_desc: For secure use of this system, we recommend the following security settings:
security.best_practices_item1: Do not use simple passwords, such as repeated characters like 111222
security.best_practices_item3: Try not to share your remote access pairing code publicly (the pairing code is only a P2P channel identifier; even if someone knows your pairing code, they still need username/password/2FA to log in to your system)
security.user_app_not_available: Please enable 2FA in the user management on your server
security.require_2fa_desc: When enabled, accounts without 2FA cannot log in
